name: codex-speed-pet
description: A local Codex token speed car dashboard

scripts.test:parity: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust.ps1 build --locked && node tests/tauri-parity.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:reference && npm run test:rust && npm run test:parity && node --test tests/tauri-update.test.cjs tests/tauri-release.test.cjs
scripts.test:window: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust.ps1 build --release --locked --features custom-protocol && node tests/tauri-ui.test.cjs
scripts.test:topmost: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/rust.ps1 build --locked && node tests/tauri-window.test.cjs
scripts.test:reference: node --test tests/usage.test.cjs tests/topmost.test.cjs tests/release.test.cjs tests/release-actions.test.cjs tests/prune-local.test.cjs tests/update.test.cjs tests/main.test.cjs
